preserved_nine_TL_rules.inheritance: Import the complete original online rules, choice domain, common held/fair wrapper, observation restrictions and tie rules unchanged. This file adds source/domain/lifetime limits to the preparation/reservation controls; it does not edit any of the nine policies or relabel a posthoc best-of-policy envelope as one online policy.
preserved_nine_TL_rules.limits: O-turn's serial turnaround theorem is not applicable to the current independent R and W memory services. O-two-stage's exact result is usable only when its full independent fixed-stage domain is proven. No artificial turn tau is added.

comparison_origins.descriptor_t0: All relevant tasks become available together, before their preparation and address offers. Include all ordinary preparation, source fragmentation, AR/R/AW/W/B, true task completion and fault/quiet work. Ordinary controls may prevent an unsafe source AR here, with their actual paid interfaces and capacity.
comparison_origins.fresh_TL_t0: The complete same accepted history is frozen immediately before a legal merged NormalTL first VALID. A new policy cannot recall an accepted source AR or turn an unprepared mapping into prehistory. A stronger descriptor-admission control may be compared from descriptor_t0, but is not an event-equivalent action from this already accepted t0 unless its certificate/reservation already exists.
comparison_origins.held_t0: If the merged TL request or memory R beat is already held VALID, changing the chosen bank/beat is forbidden. A prevention claim must start before that commitment and pay everything needed to reach it.
comparison_origins.terminal: The comparison ends only after every selected task's actual completion, all accepted source R and issued physical W/B obligations, TL/DS in-flight work, buffers and response ownership have retired and fault/quiet checks settle. A V-DONE window does not end the DSpriority intervention or erase A/B/fault work.

ready_and_prepared_domains.meaning: A queued normal AW passes the W-overflow check, creates an ordinary WRITE translation request and waits for its real response. WRITE is preferred to READ within this bank's IDLE state. A successful response can then drive normal completion AW.
ready_and_prepared_domains.not_implied: This is not a nonclaiming PA/permission preparation service before the upstream AW mux. The ordinary virtual AW has already entered the native request path; first AW offer also commits its upstream W owner.
ready_and_prepared_domains.scope: Normal native request only; read_admit and native special-result/fault routing remain intact.

ready_and_prepared_domains.meaning: In this saved two-DMA test source, paw_count advances only on comp AWVALID&&AWREADY. aw_count and virtual/physical order observations come from the respective mux's first AW offer. Prepared means the matching concrete ordinary physical completion AW has actually been accepted, not merely pending AWVALID, a PTE cache hit or a task-name guess.
ready_and_prepared_domains.matching: One active aligned normal 4096-byte task per indexed source; source and destination offsets match, AR/AW len and size match, INCR and 64-bit beats. Current virtual/physical W heads and per-source sequence numbers are checked. Bank-only matching is legitimate only because this saved test indexes the two specific source streams; it is not a general four-flow/full-ID certificate.
ready_and_prepared_domains.not_implied: An arbitrary longer source AR spanning future destination children is not covered by a prepared current AW. A comp AW acceptance is not DDR W completion, final B or a revocation-stable page lease.

ready_and_prepared_domains.meaning: All byte lanes in the current W mask are present in the data FIFO; first_possible checks the first W mask. First R handshake is sufficient only for the explicitly aligned one-to-one burst contract.
ready_and_prepared_domains.not_implied: Arbitrary alignment, decoupled R/W segment sizes or a future destination child are not granted by a bare first-R pulse.

ready_and_prepared_domains.meaning: The native certificate requires capacity>=4096 bytes, one normal aligned 4096-byte job and no unexpected job overlap/retirement. It tracks accepted frontend jobs and actual backend job completion. This is a concrete restricted whole-job capacity certificate.
ready_and_prepared_domains.not_implied: It is not a dynamic arbitrary-burst allocator. Job FIFO acceptance differs from backend execution start. A descriptor that merely has length<=capacity cannot certify overlapping unaccounted accepted returns.

ready_and_prepared_domains.meaning: Before a nonreserved source AR first offer, successful READ and independent WRITE authorization cover the exact whole return envelope and every destination child. PA/range, original flow/operation, precise byte mapping and retirement ownership are retained.
ready_and_prepared_domains.native_status: This is a complete prospective ordinary construction already written in stage83, not a implemented native interface or a published whole combined design. Current top request/response fields have no prepared-parent origin/lease completion port.
ready_and_prepared_domains.not_implied: An IOTLB valid bit, equal PA, fake debug/ATS operation, permission on only the first child, or a single B does not establish the whole certificate.

controls.kind: source-bound full-run extension of the existing memory-model priority control
frozen_rule: Keep this intervention enabled from common t0 through all task and R/W/B/fault/quiet retirement, without a V-DONE or win_open cut-off.

At an unheld R selection opportunity, choose the earliest already accepted DS request in mem_q if it can move ahead of the current non-DS request while preserving full-source-ID ordering. The native shared-DDR ID is preserved verbatim.
Otherwise continue the current head. Once RVALID was offered and stalled, keep exactly that beat and header until its handshake; no priority change can move it.

Preserve each request's accepted_cycle, remaining latency, beat count, address and response state. Do not insert a future PTE, change native AR acceptance, add capacity or reorder any same-ID request. W and B retain their own native ownership/service.
controls.raw_existing_limit: Current source's ds_window condition is legacy win_open or full_era && full_done_n[0]<v_transfers. That old windowed execution is not the required full-run control for this round. No old source was edited or old experiment rerun here.
controls.information: Only accepted DS class, full ID, current committed R-valid state and actual queue entries at the memory policy point; no future PTE/PA/RREADY oracle.
controls.logical_resources: Same mem_q size, same R output stage, same per-request state and one native DS path. A prospective private validation would add only the correctly scoped priority-enable rule, not a second memory service.
controls.cannot_cover: A not-yet-accepted next PTE or an already held payload R cannot be promoted. Source-side launch/preparation/lease obligations are not repaired by DSpriority alone.

controls.kind: existing saved test control; exact restricted predicates preserved
frozen_rule: For a current stream, require exact source/destination offset, length and size, active task, current virtual and physical W owner, actual matching comp AW acceptance and matching consumed W sequence.

For the immediate next same-source stream, require it be next in both virtual and physical W-owner queues, its matching AW accepted, the preceding stream itself drainable, identical read ID and the exact sequence conditions in future_drain. A preceding pooled return must already be fully resident before the future stream is committed.

Latch completion admission armed_q before allowing the native completion AR to enter its mux; record full completion ID/address/len/size, retain that offered request and clear the grant only on actual completion AR handshake.

Mode7 uses streaming only: no unused pool array is treated as real reserved payload capacity. Metadata may be captured separately, but every actual nonreserved return requires this concrete drain certificate.

If SourceReadGateEnable is used, apply the same exact predicate before virtual source AR to avoid an unrelated per-bank AR queue head. This can lose early translation; that work/latency must be counted.
controls.domain: Saved two real iDMA test, one active aligned DEFAULT 4KiB job per indexed source, native same-source order, fixed successful normal mapping. It does not establish a general four-DMA/multiple-job/fault/revocation contract.
controls.lifetime: Virtual/physical write order advances on the respective real WLAST handshake; physical AW preparation on comp AW handshake. Source metadata persists through delivered upstream RLAST. Actual task completion remains final backend write response, not RLAST or virtual WLAST.
controls.source_VALID_boundary: Saved source_read_release_q updates are mistakenly located only in the reset branch (payload snapshot lines327-328; earlier write-order snapshot272-273). No normal-operation sticky update exists. Restricted predicate stability may suffice for the old tested scenes, but a general source AR firstVALID lock is not proven by this variable or its comment. This round preserves the historical code and does not claim a new failure/run.
controls.logical_resources: Exact per-source job mapping, queued AR metadata, AW shape/sequence observation, virtual/physical W-order references, physical comp-AW acceptance, admission lock and fault/terminal accounting; no new payload pool in Mode7. Existing test counters/observers are not area measurements.

controls.kind: existing saved simplified ordinary frontier control
controls.frozen_rule: Retain current/next exact rules above. For the extra frontier case use current virtual W owner plus exact offset/len/size and actual matching comp AW accepted, with FrontierScanEnable=false. The physical-prefix scan is an independent fault16 observer, not part of this simplified functional decision.
controls.coverage_limit: Existing restricted saved source and its historical observations cover overlap with predecessor physical W tails after their payload was accepted at virtual WLAST. This is not a theorem for arbitrary four-flow/multiple-job state or infinite backpressure; a merely asserted physical AW is insufficient.
controls.lifetime: The additional grant and full completion header are locked before completion AR offer. Virtual-WLAST means the payload is held downstream; it is not DDR completion or B. Exact job/ID state cannot be reused before its real completion boundary.
controls.logical_resources: Simplified predicate need not include the entire functional prefix-scan state; any observation wiring and remaining exact metadata/matching/commit state is still paid. No logical payload pool is added.

controls.kind: concrete existing capacity control plus an explicitly bounded reservation rule
frozen_rule: Before physical source AR firstVALID reserve actual exclusive capacity for every return beat not independently drainable under already retained permissions and order. Include every earlier accepted/held source AR; never double-count the same private/shared position.

In saved Mode5, a free 256-beat slot per source is selected and marked before armed_q completion admission; count_q tracks received-not-replayed beats. The source return may be accepted without waiting for its WRITE drain because its entire response has a real reserved slot.

Physical RLAST ends memory reception, while the shared slot remains live through final upstream response delivery. A byte may leave the slot only into an actual accepted downstream storage/consumption position. Permission, W and B lifetime remains independent.

The native 512-beat full-job buffer/certificate is another concrete restricted way to reserve all 4KiB returned data, subject to its one eligible job invariant. A three-beat FIFO is not silently enlarged or assigned an inactive test array.
controls.partial_tail_limit: An accurate cut-through plus reserved suffix may use max(0,L-p) reserved return bytes only when p is a certified independently drainable prefix with complete WRITE coverage and already lawful owner path for all those bytes. A transient WREADY or permission on only the current child does not prove p. No unpublished native partial-tail implementation is asserted here.
controls.can_cover: Prevents a source from exhausting its owned return capacity even if a later PTE cannot bypass a held beat, provided the full reservation is already real at the shared comparison origin.
controls.same_resource_limit: Mode5/private full buffering consumes real payload storage. It is not an equal-resource competitor against three-beat-only methods unless those exact slots exist in both budgets. It cannot reserve new capacity retroactively at fresh_TL_t0.

controls.kind: one frozen ordinary return-envelope selection projection; source-derived prospective paid snapshot, not native-free or a published whole mechanism
controls.choice_domain: Exactly the same two legal native bank heads before merged NormalTL firstVALID; READ/READ as well as READ/WRITE combinations are eligible. NativeN bypass, read_admit, AW-before-AR within each bank, W-overflow, one PTW and same-ID/owner constraints remain frozen. A bank tag is not an original DMA source identity.

paid_snapshot.head_binding: Exact original full source ID, DID/PID/access identity and certified job/envelope/byte correspondence of the already captured native head. Do not infer the source/job from only its bank or a role label.
paid_snapshot.return_footprint: Resident unread/unwritten payload and all already memory-offered/accepted source returns associated with the head, with exact remaining bytes/masks and exclusive storage ownership. For an already input-accepted virtual READ whose physical AR has not yet been offered, its captured immutable burst shape supplies the additional exact footprint that completing this head would permit. Distinguish virtual acceptance from physical memory commitment and count each byte/position once. No future descriptor or unaccepted future child is invented.
paid_snapshot.available_storage: Actual currently available exclusively usable byte-FIFO, spill/return and reserved positions on this full source's path, including carried allocations and irrevocable ownership. Another source's occupied slots, an inactive test array or coarse bank permission is not available space.
paid_snapshot.drain_certificate: Only complete validated WRITE coverage and actual ordered W lease/owner path that can independently advance for the specified bytes without first needing a further unreserved/unprepared source return. Full original source must match every relevant W-order domain. A currently unrelated owner at the same bank, bare AWVALID, first-R pulse, transient WREADY or permission on only the first child is not a true drain certificate.
paid_snapshot.safe_READ: The captured READ's complete exact footprint, including every already carried source return and resident byte, fits genuinely available exclusive source capacity plus explicitly paid disjoint full intermediate return reservations; alternatively the entire footprint is covered by a true independently advancing W drain certificate. A native512-beat sole aligned4KiB fullbuffer certificate can establish the first sufficient condition without any AW already prepared. Count every intermediate position and reservation lifetime; no duplicated/shared/unavailable slot credit.
paid_snapshot.safe_WRITE: The WRITE head is already native-legal and its exact certified transition has corresponding source data actually available or an existing independently advancing W lease/path; it must not introduce an uncovered source-return footprint or an ownership dependency preventing the intended drain. Preserve its real normal-TL/PTE service and W/B/fault obligations. This certificate must be supplied by root's actual interface/ownership derivation; WRITE type alone is not proof of safe progress.
paid_snapshot.unknown: Any missing full-source/job binding, storage accounting, accepted-return shape, WRITE coverage, W-lease/order association or safe-WRITE certificate makes the corresponding envelope judgment unknown.

predicates.unsafe_READ: Certified uncovered envelope: after the exact already captured READ completes, at least one of its owned/immediately permitted accepted-return bytes cannot fit the currently usable exclusive positions and cannot legally advance through the certified W lease. This is a concrete finite-return obligation test, not a prediction of future PTE count, PA, RREADY or memory direction.
predicates.safe_READ: The paid snapshot proves the entire footprint is covered by actual exclusive full-return capacity/reservation or a complete independent W-drain certificate. No AW is required for the real full-reservation sufficient condition. Failure to prove safe is unknown unless unsafe is independently certified; it is never automatically unsafe.
predicates.safe_WRITE: The snapshot contains the complete certified safe-WRITE transition above. A missing/ambiguous dependency remains unknown, not false-by-bank-name proof.
predicates.no_capacity_invention: No control creates a reservation, moves payload, inserts an AR/PTE or deletes a carried accepted prefix merely by setting a safe/unsafe flag.

frozen_rule: Keep an already offered/held NormalTL grant and header until its native acceptance. Enforce the inherited fairness reservation/forced choice before this preference. Neither may be displaced to avoid a hazard.
If only one native head is legal, use native selection. Never manufacture a second head or add a source hold/admission rule to make this selector appear safer.

If exactly one head is certified safe and the other is a certified unsafe READ, choose that safe head first. A safe READ with real complete capacity is as eligible as a safe WRITE with actual supply/lease. Apply the same rule after exchanging all bank/source/context/owner fields together.

Otherwise use the inherited age/RR tie: greater trustworthy nonsaturated paid head age first when available, native RR otherwise. This covers two safe heads, two unsafe heads, missing/unknown certificates, two WRITEs and already unsafe carried prefixes without a certified legal remedy. It never uses an imagined future to resolve unknown.

Commit the selected unchanged NormalTL header before its first merged VALID and preserve it until actual accept. Advance native RR and fairness only at actual native acceptance. Future PTE service and all R/W/B/fault retirement follow the unchanged native system.
controls.same_state_hand_verdict: For a fresh, unforced, two-legal-head state with one certified unsafe READ and one certified safe head, this one rule chooses the safe head, exactly as a candidate whose claimed action is safe-before-dangerous-READ. The safe head may be a READ with full return capacity or a WRITE with true supply/lease. This equality uses only the already paid envelope/owner snapshot and not two AB/BA rollouts. Root must still establish this exact state's reachability, complete safety predicates and full event/retirement equality. It is not a statement about unknown identity, two hazards or already unsafe accepted prefix.
controls.logical_resources: Paid full-source/head-to-envelope binding, exact native burst bytes and all carried return ownership, actual available capacity and complete W-lease/permission/order validity; two safe/unsafe judgments and a two-way choice added to the existing held/fair/RR selector. No stored or computed dual AB/BA schedule, historical turnaround estimator, future walk/PA oracle or extra payload/translation port is required by this control. Exact observation/routing/comparison/state/timing costs remain unfrozen and are shared with any candidate using those inputs.
controls.can_cover: The concrete certified unsafe-READ/safe-head hazard pair at the same fresh-TL origin, if root proves all predicates. It does not retroactively prevent a prefix accepted before this origin or guarantee progress when fairness forces the hazardous head. The source-relative sufficient condition detects uncovered-return hazard; it is not a theorem that every possible future memory service must create heldR.

controls.kind: complete prospective ordinary construction from stage83; native primitive sources verified
frozen_rule: Enable from a quiescent or fully accounted source state. Bind descriptor/full original flow, source READ, all destination WRITE extents, exact byte correspondence, true return capacities and child completion ownership.

Obtain the complete successful permissions through paid normal-semantic preparation before source firstVALID. If ordinary normal AW preparation is used, retain all resulting actual AW/W-order/B obligations. A nonclaiming prepare origin and trusted retained-PA lookup are added interfaces, paid equally if supplied to either method.

Use a fair fixed RR selection among ready envelopes. Allocate exactly one non-full-reserved source primer before its source AR first offer and retain it through every destination child. Other reads need a full real return reservation or wait; preparing them does not grant a second unreserved stream.

For aligned one-to-one R/AW segments the existing local first-R coupler can release that AW. For one AR feeding several destination AW children, require an explicit per-child first-writable-byte trigger matched to its retained envelope; the stock one-credit-per-first-R module does not supply these extra credits.

Before each child AW firstVALID retain immutable full header, exact operation/range and lawful W-order permission. Child/parent descriptors are generated before every shared W-owner mux; owner ordering and same-ID order cannot be rewritten downstream.
Release the primer only after all envelope true bytes cross the actual physical W interface and the final true physical WLAST, not first R, first child WLAST, virtual WLAST or synthetic/null LAST.

Keep source authorization through actual source RLAST; destination authorization, physical child response accounting and fault state through every issued physical B and all later children. Final task success waits for complete true bytes and all real responses.

Unused preparation can be discarded. Launched leases need stop-new-use plus drain/revocation and command completion. Fixed stable mappings are the first limited domain; a generation counter alone cannot solve invalidation or generation wrap.

raw_coupler_boundary.fact: One first-R handshake contributes one AW credit. Legalizer RW decoupling and AW coupling are separate flags. Frontend decouple_aw stays0 while decouple_rw follows CONF bit0. A single long R segmented into multiple W children does not obtain a second AW credit from this module without separate paid child release logic or a constrained equal segmentation.
raw_coupler_boundary.consequence: The old stage83 combined ordinary control remains a specific prospective envelope rule, but its claim of using stock coupler unchanged across arbitrary children is not literally a complete source implementation. Apply the same integration bill to candidate and ordinary, rather than granting ordinary free credits or treating this gap as candidate novelty.

native_status.fact: Production RAW_COUPLING_AVAIL=0. DMA0/1 have512-beat buffers in current nonblock mode; others3. Normal TC WRITE translation is reached through queued AW. No native prepared-parent origin/completion record is present.
native_status.consequence: Do not describe this constructed ordinary control as the currently synthesized configuration or a zero-cost generic solution.

controls.coverage: Under its full fixed domain, this one frozen rule prevents both stage83 C1 and C2 and allows the same final-WLAST/B-tail overlap. This is a constructive same-action control for those capabilities, not a scene-dependent selector or proof that all fresh-TL feedback policies are equivalent.
controls.logical_resources: Same complete permissions/ranges, full source ID/job binding, existing byte FIFOs, exact child mapping, one primer owner, fair selector, prepared origin/response matching, child data-ready release and immutable AR/AW locks, trusted physical lookup/routing, all physical B/fault/invalidation lifetime. No joint AB/BA predictor, future walk knowledge or extra payload credit is needed for this prevention rule.

If ordinary needs additional preparation, capacity or interfaces, compare their complete paid budgets instead of assuming free availability. Neither possibility alone decides fresh-TL feedback family novelty.
